summary: the five rows of installed_test.sh on i686, the acceptance's rows that read the command line, the disk and the ext2 root, on the tree's metal_accept.sh and bootctl

argv: make -s -j4 rach2 build/tests/system/harness metal-installed-tools ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/utils/sbin/bootctl && make -s -C utils ../build/utils/sbin/bootctl ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/utils/sbin/bootctl ${WORK}/bootctl && cp tests/system/accept/metal_accept.sh ${WORK}/metal_accept.sh

rm -rf ${WORK}/rows && METAL_ACCEPT_SCRIPT=${WORK}/metal_accept.sh METAL_BOOTCTL=${WORK}/bootctl exec sh tests/system/accept/installed_test.sh build/rach2/kernel build/tests/system/harness ${WORK}/rows all

faults.name: partition
faults.summary: the acceptance takes a root mounted from the fourth partition for the installed one

faults.name: readonly
faults.summary: the acceptance takes a root mounted read-only for the installed one

faults.name: window
faults.summary: the acceptance fails a disk whose MBR it read through the whole-disk window

faults.name: gptid
faults.summary: the acceptance does not know a root named by the GUID table's disk GUID

faults.name: slot
faults.summary: bootctl reports a boot from the fallback slot as one from the candidate
